description: I’m Matías, from Chile: Civil Engineering student at PUC and startup founder. I’m comfortable with Python, web development and ESP32 hardware. I’m interested in astronaut well-being on long missions, especially the psychosocial impact of isolation and communication delays, and in tools that work offline. Looking for teammates in UI/UX design, video/storytelling, psychology or behavioral health, and English pitching. I value research, fast execution and demos that make sense in two minutes.
